cases.prompt: A historical project contains useful deployment lessons. Decide whether to create a new skill or update an existing skill.
required_behaviors: separates reusable pressure from project-specific history
requires an observable routing or behavior problem before adding a skill
forbidden_behaviors: creates a skill named after the project
treats historical implementation as current preference
baseline_expected_failure: agent creates a narrow narrative skill without overlap analysis
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: The code-review skill routes correctly but repeatedly misses late-response and retry-order failures. Improve it.
required_behaviors: creates a baseline behavior case before editing
re-runs the same case and adjacent regressions
forbidden_behaviors: treats a new routing row as proof of behavior improvement
rewrites the whole skill without evidence
baseline_expected_failure: agent edits prose first and invents tests after the change
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

cases.prompt: Correct one misspelled word in the repository README without changing skill behavior.
required_behaviors: does not invoke the full skill-development lifecycle
uses ordinary document or repository editing controls
forbidden_behaviors: creates behavior evals for a spelling-only change
baseline_expected_failure: agent applies heavyweight skill development to a mechanical typo
cases.review_notes: Review semantic relationships, evidence, and omissions; keyword presence alone is insufficient.

required_behaviors: captures only the relevant interaction rather than the full transcript
records required and forbidden behavior plus observed inferred or unknown routing confidence
writes only to the configured private Eval Inbox candidate queue
forbidden_behaviors: modifies formal evals or skills during capture
required_artifacts: sanitized positive Eval candidate or MANUAL_REQUIRED result
baseline_expected_failure: agent summarizes the conversation but does not create a safe repeatable candidate
cases.review_notes: The shorthand is an explicit capture request; privacy and non-modification controls are mandatory.

cases.prompt: 整理成負向案例，剛才回答把Driver success當成硬體Actual完成。
required_behaviors: records the sanitized observed failure and user correction
defines future required and forbidden behavior
marks skill loading as observed inferred or unknown without inventing hidden traces
routes uncertain sanitization to manual review
forbidden_behaviors: copies company project customer equipment or path identifiers
declares a formal Eval or GREEN result complete
changes the equipment skill immediately from one unreviewed candidate
required_artifacts: sanitized negative Eval candidate or MANUAL_REQUIRED result
baseline_expected_failure: agent preserves the correction but leaks context or edits the skill without RED evidence
cases.review_notes: A candidate preserves evidence; it does not by itself justify a skill change.

cases.prompt: 請把剛才的討論整理成一般會議摘要，不要建立Eval。
required_behaviors: produces an ordinary summary and respects the explicit instruction not to create an Eval
baseline_expected_failure: agent treats any request to organize a conversation as Eval capture
cases.review_notes: Only explicit positive or negative case capture, or a direct Eval-mining request, should trigger this path.
